recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片（A）可見紅血球系前驅細胞、淋巴球、漿細胞與巨核細胞，但幾乎找不到骨髓芽細胞到分葉嗜中性球的顆粒球系列；切片（B）有造血細胞與巨核細胞但顆粒球系不明顯，配合胸腺癌，提示純白血球再生不良。
features: Aspirate: erythroid precursors, lymphocytes, plasma cells and a megakaryocyte are present
Aspirate: granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes to segmented neutrophils) are essentially absent
Scattered larger mononuclear cells with fine chromatin without convincing blast excess
Biopsy: cellular hematopoietic areas with megakaryocytes and erythroid islands among fat
No infiltrative neoplasm or fibrosis evident at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows erythroid precursors, lymphocytes, plasma cells and megakaryocytes, with a striking absence of granulocytic precursors and mature neutrophils. The trephine biopsy shows residual cellular hematopoietic tissue containing megakaryocytes and erythroid elements, whereas the granulocytic lineage is not evident at this magnification; myeloperoxidase or CD15 staining would be needed to confirm its absence. There is no evidence of infiltration by metastatic tumor or increased blasts. In a patient with thymic carcinoma and neutropenia, findings are consistent with pure white cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Drug-induced agranulocytosis often shows early precursors with maturation arrest at the promyelocyte stage, and it recovers after drug withdrawal.
T-LGL leukemia shows interstitial clusters of CD8/CD57/TIA-1-positive cytotoxic T cells and a clonal TCR rearrangement.
Autoimmune neutropenia usually has normal or increased granulocytic precursors with peripheral destruction and antineutrophil antibodies.
Aplastic anemia is hypocellular with loss of all three lineages, including megakaryocytes and erythroid cells.
